summary: The subset defines strong fail-closed artifact, command, credential, and verification boundaries, but two material implementation gaps remain: the raw-ARIA fallback does not enforce its documented DNS snapshot boundary, and unresolved imported test bindings can become unsuppressible P0 findings in Cypress-proven files.

findings.title: Raw-ARIA routing does not enforce approved DNS peers
findings.evidence: The request guard checks only the request URL against the approved textual origin before continuing it. The helper receives no approved-peer snapshot and performs no address pinning or drift check, despite the public contract requiring snapshot drift to fail closed. A later localhost resolution can therefore escape the peer identity established by preflight.
findings.recommendation: Restrict this fallback to canonical numeric loopback literals and reject localhost, or run it behind a transport boundary that pins every browser connection to the preflight peer set and verifies drift before navigation.

findings.title: Unresolved imported test receiver is accepted as focused-test evidence
findings.evidence: focused_test_hit_matches returns success when the receiver is imported from an unresolved package. In a file already considered Cypress-proven by path or basename, the later file-level provenance gate can promote this binding-unresolved match to a final, unsuppressible #7 P0 rather than LLM triage, allowing an unrelated imported API named test.only to fail the scan.
findings.recommendation: Keep unresolved imported receivers in the non-gating P0-candidate ledger until their binding resolves to Playwright test; accept Cypress test/it/describe only when they are unimported, unshadowed Cypress globals.

limitations: Static packet-only review; no commands, tests, scanners, parsers, or framework runtimes were executed.
The packet omits holdouts, benchmarks, scorecards, prior reviews, repository history, and observed CI results, so no runtime success or detection accuracy is inferred.
Referenced but omitted supporting files, AST rules, fixtures, and CI test implementations could not be reviewed for parity or completeness.
This subset review is not full product coverage, independent ground truth, human or sealed review, or remote model attestation.
